entities.summary: Cisplatine Province and Independence, a transformative movement in Uruguay (1821–1828). Emerged from Treaty of Montevideo and British mediation produced the Treaty. Catalyzed Thirty-Three Orientals launch independence revolt — April 19, 1825 and Guerra Grande begins.
